gloss: end of term; end of semester

definitions.gloss: end of term; end of semester
definitions.explanation: The final period of a school term, when end-of-term exams, evaluations, and closing ceremonies take place. Used in elementary, secondary, and tertiary education.

examples.japanese: {学期末|がっきまつ}が{近|ちか}づいてきた。
examples.english: The end of the term is approaching.

examples.japanese: {学期末|がっきまつ}{試験|しけん}の{勉強|べんきょう}をしている。
examples.english: I'm studying for the end-of-term exams.

examples.japanese: {学期末|がっきまつ}には{成績表|せいせきひょう}が{配|くば}られ、{先生|せんせい}との{面談|めんだん}も{行|おこな}われる。
examples.english: At the end of the term, report cards are handed out and meetings with teachers are held.

notes:
Compound of {学期|がっき} (school term) + {末|まつ} (end). The Japanese school year has either two terms ({前期|ぜんき}/{後期|こうき}) or three trimesters ({一|いち}/{二|に}/{三|さん}{学期|がっき}), each with its own {学期末|がっきまつ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {学期末|がっきまつ}{試験|しけん}: end-of-term exam
- {学期末|がっきまつ}{テスト|てすと}: end-of-term test (casual)
- {学期末|がっきまつ}{評価|ひょうか}: end-of-term evaluation
- {学期末|がっきまつ}{休暇|きゅうか}: end-of-term break

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {学期|がっき}: school term, semester
- {期末|きまつ}: end of term (general, including work)
- {年度末|ねんどまつ}: end of the (school/fiscal) year
